prompts.dobermann_walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a production animation SPRITE SHEET for Dobermann (杜宾) from Arknights walking slowly around the base. Image 1 approved identity/costume reference. Image 2 PRTS face identity reference. Image 3 Amiya walk sheet is STYLE and GRID reference only; do not copy Amiya's identity, weapons or cape. EXACTLY FOUR columns and EIGHT rows of full-body chibi sprites, 32 separate sprites on a regular equal grid, image 1024x2048, nominal cells 256 square. Arknights chibi proportions ~3 heads high with big head and small body, clean bold dark outline, full-color flat painted shading, matching Amiya source. Dobermann: long straight dark navy hair, tall narrow canine ears with brown interiors, small forehead brown markings, brown eyes, studded black choker, cropped dark navy instructor jacket with orange-brown inner sleeves, bare midriff, wide navy trousers, brown gloves and ankle boots. Whip COILED at hip at rest in all frames; hands otherwise relaxed. No combat. ROW ORDER, top to bottom: 1 S front facing viewer; 2 SW front three-quarter facing screen LEFT; 3 W strict left profile; 4 NW rear three-quarter facing upper LEFT, back of head, NO EYES/face; 5 N straight back, NO face; 6 NE rear three-quarter facing upper RIGHT, NO EYES/face; 7 E strict right profile; 8 SE front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT. In EACH row four consecutive steps: frame1 left foot forward right back, frame2 passing feet near together, frame3 right foot forward left back, frame4 opposite passing. Opposite arms swing gently, visible alternating foot separation, hair moves modestly. Hold direction consistent within row. Same character scale, centred at x128 of each cell and feet at y240. Ears and boots entirely inside each cell, generous clear transparent gutters between all figures. TRUE transparent background, no gridlines, ground shadows, text, symbols, watermark, extra sprites. Do not merge or omit rows.
prompts.kaltsit_walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET of Kal'tsit (凯尔希) from Arknights slowly walking in the base. Input 1 approved normal-proportion painting for costume/identity only. Input2 PRTS facial identity. Input3 Amiya sheet for CHIBI ART STYLE and row orientation reference only. EXACTLY 4 columns x 8 rows, 32 full-body separate chibi sprites, regular equal grid, portrait sheet 1024x2048, nominal 256x256 cells. Chibi ~3 heads high, large head, small limbs, clean dark outlines and full-colour flat painted shading matching Amiya. Pale green-silver bob and long side locks, upright cat ears with black tips and yellow inner fur, green eyes, black and gold choker, lime-green short asymmetric dress, long WHITE medical coat with black cuffs and hem, bare shins, brown ankle boots; coat must dominate silhouette. Hands EMPTY relaxed at sides, no weapon, no Mon3tr, no bag. Each row a four-frame gentle everyday walk, NOT combat: 1 left foot forward, 2 passing feet closer with body slightly up, 3 right foot forward, 4 opposite passing. Distinct boot positions and opposite subtle arm swing, natural coat swing, no running. ROWS top to bottom in SCREEN directions: 1 S front facing viewer; 2 SW front three-quarter facing screen LEFT; 3 W strict left profile; 4 NW rear three-quarter facing upper LEFT, back of head NO FACE or eyes, coat opening points LEFT; 5 N straight back NO FACE; 6 NE rear three-quarter facing upper RIGHT, back of head NO FACE or eyes, coat opening points RIGHT; 7 E strict right profile; 8 SE front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT. Match each row orientation consistently over all 4 steps. All sprites equal scale, fully inside their own cells, ears and boots not cropped, clear gutters, feet baseline y240 per cell, body centre x128. TRUE transparent background, no shadows or floor, no grid, no text, symbols, watermark or labels. All 8 direction rows and all four columns must be present.
prompts.dobermann_idle: Create a production IDLE SPRITE SHEET for Dobermann from Arknights, chibi style exactly matching attached WALK sprite sheet (image1), PRTS avatar (image2) for facial identity. 2 columns x 8 rows, SIXTEEN separate full-body chibi sprites on equal regular cells, 512x2048 intended output. Both columns show the SAME relaxed standing pose, feet side by side FLAT and PARALLEL, arms relaxed hanging, no walk, no lunge. This is neutral idle, no feet movement. Long navy hair, tall brown-inside canine ears, brown eyes and forehead spots, cropped navy jacket orange inner sleeve, bare midriff, wide navy trousers, brown gloves and boots. WHIP COILED at hip, not held out. ROWS TOP TO BOTTOM: S front; SW front three-quarter looking screen left; W left profile; NW rear three-quarter facing UP LEFT, back of head not face; N straight back; NE rear three-quarter facing UP RIGHT, back of head not face; E right profile; SE front three-quarter looking screen right. Rear rows NW/N/NE have ZERO visible eyes, nose or face; NW/NE must be visibly angled, with side of shoulder and cheek fully occluded by hair. Same chibi proportions, character scale and full-colour painted source style as walk ref, crisp dark outlines. Keep every ear and boot inside its own cell, clear gutters, same centre and foot baseline. Exactly 8 rows and 2 columns. No words, labels, grid, floor shadow, watermark. True transparent background.
prompts.kaltsit_idle: Create a production IDLE SPRITE SHEET for Kal'tsit from Arknights. Image1 PRTS approved identity/costume painting. Image2 Kal'tsit chibi walk STYLE and scale reference, but correct the coat to be LONG to the knees and correct diagonal rear facings. Exactly 2 columns x 8 rows, 16 fully separate full-body chibi sprites, regular equal grid on transparent background, 512x2048 intended output. Both columns SAME neutral idle standing pose: feet flat side by side, no step, no walking; arms hang relaxed and hands EMPTY. ~3 heads high, pale mint silver bob with longer side locks, black tipped cat ears with yellow inner fur, green eyes, black-and-gold choker, lime-green dress under a LONG WHITE medical coat that falls to just above ankles in chibi proportions, black cuffs and hem; brown ankle boots. Long white coat is her dominant silhouette, not a waist jacket. Clean thick dark outlines, full-colour flat shading like Amiya crew sprites. ROW ORDER top to bottom: S front viewer; SW front three-quarter facing screen LEFT; W left profile; NW three-quarter REAR facing up-left, show back of head and coat, NO EYES/NO FACE; N straight back; NE three-quarter REAR facing up-right, show back of head and coat, NO EYES/NO FACE; E strict right profile; SE front three-quarter facing screen RIGHT. NW and NE are back views with asymmetrical shoulder/ear placement, not side profiles. No face in any of rows 4,5,6. Keep every sprite entire from ear tip to boot sole, consistent scale, clear empty gutters. No ground shadows, text, gridlines, labels, symbols, watermark, weapons, Mon3tr. True transparent background. Exactly eight rows and two columns.

Chibi 3 heads high, long dark navy straight hair, pointed narrow brown-inside dog ears, dark navy instructor jacket with orange-brown inner sleeves, loose navy trousers and brown ankle boots, brown gloves, whip COILED at hip at rest. Hands not on hips. Preserve identity and original full-colour painted chibi source style, clear bold outlines. All ten sprites identical scale, fully visible with generous transparent gutters. True transparent background, no floor shadow, no text, grid, symbols, watermark or extra figures.
